status: implemented, qualified against baseline and committed; original goal active
findings: Aabb2::from_points under APPROXIMATE_512 returns a box whose max_x is strictly below an input coordinate 1-cos(2^-607). Its STRICT contains_point rejects that input.
The edge-preview from_arc branch uses rounded f64 cardinal coordinates. An arc on the radius-squared-3 circle returns max_y strictly below sqrt(3), excluding its swept top cardinal point.
has_valid_ordering under APPROXIMATE_512 accepts min_x=1-cos(2^-619), max_x=0.
singleton_intersection under APPROXIMATE_512 constructs the origin as the intersection of two distinct point boxes, at x=0 and x=1-cos(2^-619).
intended_migration: Remove geometry context arguments from Aabb2 constructors, hull expansion/union, ordering validation and singleton construction. Use certified scalar comparisons and native arc sweep decisions; retain conservative full-circle fallback on uncertainty. Migrate all callers and now-contextless control-hull helpers directly, with no aliases.
constraints: Do not silently weaken smallest-hull promises or narrow arbitrary exact Real payloads to rationals.
Pure bound construction may decline when exact order is unresolved; no approximation can become enclosure evidence.
Preserve explicit geometry operation policy and retained-object identity outside the context-free arithmetic/construction APIs.
Audit predicate-only box queries separately: their topology policy and preview behavior are different contracts.
Test both contexts, fresh near-zero expressions, reversed corners, distinct singleton boxes, irrational arc extrema and preview adapters.

baseline_tests.finding: All four independent regressions fail on the old construction/evidence APIs.

migration.scope: Aabb2 constructors, hull expansion/union, ordering and singleton evidence; control-hull and prepared-bound helpers; native structural facts. Owning geometry operations keep their contexts.
migration.caller_validation: All-target checks for Hypercurve and HyperBREP, plus workspace source scan. One HyperBREP builder caller migrated directly.
migration.production_semantics: Only strict scalar/sweep decisions can construct evidence. Rounded preview arc-bound branch removed; full-circle uncertainty fallback retained. Topology-only query contracts remain separate.
